measurement_note: The workload size n is both the list length and maximum value. Strictly increasing nums = [1, ..., n] exercises value-indexed initialization and transitions; each value i belongs to i(n-i+1) valid ranges, giving a closed-form expected total.

generator.source:
n = 1000
modulus = 1_000_000_007
case = {'nums': list(range(1, n + 1))}
sum_squares = n * (n + 1) * (2 * n + 1) // 6
sum_cubes = (n * (n + 1) // 2) ** 2
expected = ((n + 1) * sum_squares - sum_cubes) % modulus
